stories.story_fr: MPS realise un chiffre d'affaires record de 804 millions de dollars au T1 2026, en hausse de 26 % sur un an, porte par l'IA et les infrastructures reseau.
stories.story_en: MPS posts a record quarterly revenue of $804M in Q1 2026, up 26% YoY, driven by AI infrastructure and networking demand.
stories.quote: MPS achieved record quarterly revenue of $804.2 million, 7.1% higher than the fourth quarter of 2025 and 26.1% higher

stories.story_fr: Le segment Enterprise Data (serveurs IA) bondit de 98 % sur un an a 263 millions de dollars, representant desormais 33 % du chiffre d'affaires total.
stories.story_en: Enterprise Data (AI servers) surges 98% YoY to $263M, now representing 33% of total revenue.
stories.signal: Enterprise Data quasi-doublement en un an
stories.quote: The sequential increase was driven by higher sales of our power management solutions for AI and server applications

stories.story_fr: Les revenus Communications progressent de 55 % sur un an et de 33 % sequentiellement a 112 millions, tires par les modules optiques pour l'IA.
stories.story_en: Communications revenue grows 55% YoY and 33% QoQ to $112M, driven by optical module power solutions for AI.
stories.quote: Our Communications end market grew 33% sequentially on the strength of our power solutions for optical modules and switches

stories.story_fr: MPS releve son objectif de capacite de production a 6 milliards de dollars, depassant l'ancien plan de 4 milliards, pour saisir la demande IA a long terme.
stories.story_en: MPS raises its production capacity target to $6B, up from the prior $4B plan, to capture long-term AI demand.
stories.signal: Objectif capacite releve de 4 Mds$ a 6 Mds$
stories.quote: MPS continued to grow our capacity past our original $4B plan, with a new goal of reaching $6B in the near future

stories.story_fr: MPS echantillonne ses premiers produits d'interface haute vitesse pour DDR5 aupres de grands clients, ouvrant un nouveau marche memoire serveur.
stories.story_en: MPS samples its first high-speed interface products for DDR5 at major customers, opening a new server memory market.
stories.signal: Premiers produits DDR5 en phase d'echantillonnage
stories.quote: We sampled our first high speed interface products for DDR5 at major customers

stories.story_fr: La marge operationnelle GAAP atteint 30 %, en hausse de 3,5 points sur un an, et le benefice net GAAP progresse de 43 % a 193 millions de dollars.
stories.story_en: GAAP operating margin reaches 30%, up 3.5pts YoY, while GAAP net income grows 43% YoY to $193M.
stories.signal: Marge operationnelle 30 % : +3,5 pts sur un an
stories.quote: GAAP Operating Margin 30.0% ... 3.5 pts YoY Change ... Net income ($M) $193.2 ... 43.1% YoY
